shortDescription: LG 30" Black Electric Cooktop features 5 electric radiant elements for all your cooking needs, UltraHeat™ 3.2kW element for rapid heating and true simmering and 2-in-1 dual elements that let you adjust the size to accommodate different sizes of cookware.

features.text: UltraHeat™ 3.2kW Element for Rapid Boil or True Simmer

With 3,200 watts of power, our UltraHeat™ element is powerful enough to rapidly boil water and flexible enough to turn down to a true simmer. Plus, thanks to our 2-in-1, dual element design, you can conveniently adjust the size of the element to accommodate 6-inch and 9-inch cookware.
Heat Larger Cookware with Flexible Elements
The 2-in-1, dual element design, you can conveniently adjust the size of the element to accommodate 6-inch and 9-inch cookware.
The perfect harmony between style and convenience. Enjoy sleek, seamless design alongside intuitive features like size-adaptable elements and intuitive controls.

The backlit LED SmoothTouch® glass controls deliver sleek style, high-definition-visibility and easy operation, with just a touch of your finger. The controls appear hidden when off, for a minimalistic, low-profile look. Plus, the smooth surface easily wipes clean for a design that is as practical as it is stylish.
A Smarter Home Starts with the LG ThinQ® App

The ThinQ app offers control and convenience for smart LG appliances to help you simplify life and enjoy the comforts of home. Manage and monitor your cooktop remotely, sync it with your smart LG hood or over-the-range microwave to auto-activate the light and vent, and more. ThinQ Care appliances send usage, maintenance, and diagnostic alerts to help them run smoothly. ThinQ UP appliances receive software updates for new features and enhancements
Sync with Smart LG Hoods and Over-the-Range Microwaves

For a seamless cooking experience, sync with your smart LG Hood or Over-the-Range Microwave via the ThinQ® app. This feature automatically activates the Hood or Microwave's fan and light when the cooktop burners are in use and deactivates them when the burners are turned off.
